name: Darius
bio: Darius, king of Persia, had the royal archives searched after receiving Tatnai's inquiry and found Cyrus's original decree authorizing the Jerusalem temple's rebuilding. He ordered Tatnai and Shethar-bozenai to leave the work alone, to fund it fully from the royal tribute, to supply the priests' offerings day by day, and decreed that anyone who altered this order would be impaled on a beam torn from his own house, his house turned into a rubbish heap (Ezra 6:1-12). Through his order and the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo, the Jews finished the temple in his sixth year, and it was dedicated with joy and a kept Passover (Ezra 6:13-22).
